_comment: Hologram models (VECTOR's format: vector's tools/holo/collection.py and assets/holo/README.md). Boxes are [x0,x1, y0,y1, z0,z1] in fractions of the normalised bounding box (y up, front +z); a face goes to the first part whose box holds its centroid, else to the part with rest=true. bind names the live reading a part shows (VECTOR's holo/bind.py), empty for a part that only shapes the model. Sources are in src/; the baked NAME.holo.npz sit next to this file. Rebake: ~/.local/share/bromigos/venv/bin/python <vector>/tools/holo/bake.py --root THIS_DIR --preview

parts.label: RELAY
parts.hint: The relay hangs from the dead crane's jib over the foundry floor. Lit while every channel on the network answers

parts.label: JIB
parts.hint: The jib over lines that still pour metal for wars that ended decades ago: nobody left could cancel the orders

parts.label: CAB
parts.hint: Brask's post: the cab and machinery deck of a dead forge crane. The black flame is cast into its counterweight. He builds masts and housings for the other posts up here

parts.label: TOWER
parts.hint: The lattice tower the forge-golems climb. One that comes down from Brask's crane doesn't carry a gun mount any more: it carries masts

parts.label: PEDESTAL
parts.hint: Riveted footings on the foundry floor, between the lava rivers, under a sky lit orange at all hours
